{{Quote|My primary programming was installed by Lord Alferon Choots Bemming, the owner and chief operating officer of Bibliotron Systems|[[P-RC3]]|<ref name="DS" />}}
The '''Bemming family''' was a family that included [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Alferon Choots Bemming]], who was the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] and owner of [[Bibliotron Systems]], and was also the heir to the fortune of [[Bibliotron Systems]]. The family also owned one of the largest private [[Library/Legends|libraries]] of hard-copy [[Book/Legends|books]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], with a collection of over seven million volumes.<ref name="DS" />
